# The documentation-only path set. One pattern per line; blank lines and lines
# beginning with '#' are ignored.
#
# This file is the single definition. A branch touching nothing outside these
# paths does not bump the version in pyproject.toml and does not release, per
# the Versioning section of AGENTS.md -- which points here rather than
# restating the set, because three independent spellings of "docs-only" had
# already drifted apart once.
#
# Patterns follow GitHub Actions path-filter glob rules, which scripts/docs_only.py
# implements: '*' matches within one path segment, '**' crosses segments.
docs/**
mkdocs.yml
*.md
